title: Savings interest accrual and application control
workflow: Select approved terms and effective rate per historical period
Choose authorized calendar, day-count and eligibility method
Read verified historical accounting balances and exclusions
Compute exact accrual with reproducible intermediate calculations
Review exception cases and tax treatment under qualified policy
Request idempotent balanced posting and reconcile final credit
invariants: Backdated corrections must not overwrite earlier posted interest
Dormancy, restriction and tax impacts are policy-versioned, not guessed
Accrual calculation alone cannot create a customer balance
Rounding must be deterministic per approved currency rule
Unapproved PCEC mapping blocks operational interest posting
approval_gate: Bank-approved interest methodology, applicable law, CFO posting rules and property tests.
